verse.verse_1: The deniers of truth from among the People of the Book and the polytheists would not desist from disbelief until they received clear evidence --
verse.verse_2: a messenger from God, reciting to them pure scriptures,
verse.verse_4: Those who were given the Book did not become divided except after clear evidence was given to them.
verse.verse_5: They were commanded only to worship God, offering Him sincere devotion, to be sincere in their faith, to pray regularly; and to give alms, for that is the right religion.
verse.verse_6: Those of the deniers of truth among the People of the Book and the polytheists will dwell forever in Hell-fire. They are the worst of creatures.
verse.verse_7: Truly, those who believe and do good works are the best of creatures.
verse.verse_8: God has a reward in store for them: Gardens of eternity, through which rivers flow; they will dwell therein forever. God is well pleased with them and they are well pleased with Him. Thus shall the God-fearing be rewarded.
